notes: All variants sample the same saved PCM from the pre-existing band/count pilot. Native 16- and 30-mic spirals share a simulated source waveform; aperture 20 cm.
20–40 kHz processing, 192 ksample/s, ±30° azimuth and elevation, 3° scan grid; FOV is 60° span on each scan axis.
Dense reference is 53 bins and 15 overlapping 512-sample windows (4096 samples). Compact versions use 4 or 8 uniformly spaced bins and only the first 512 samples.
Wide format: window18/Q16, spectrum24/Q22, coefficients18/Q16, power48/Q32. Narrow:16/Q14 for window/spectrum/coefficients, power48/Q28. Both use 16/Q15 PCM and 1024 phase positions.
Attenuation scales sources and noise together: it isolates absolute-level arithmetic limits, not a changing acoustic SNR. No automatic gain was added.
Kernel checked bit-for-bit against two saved full-sized RTL simulation maps. Study bypasses PDM decimation, live scheduling and UART.
Synthetic point-source pilot, three seeds. Peak matches are map diagnostics, not field detection probabilities. Zero maps are explicitly excluded from peak matching.
Cost values are synthesis-calibrated screening estimates; only the separate documented configurations have measured gate counts. Averaging reference is not claimed to fit 300k.
